govdocs-archive_org-masters-mahan-compan: The Masters Mahan Podcast Companion Materials — creator unknown — accompany the Masters Mahan podcast. The file’s context is unclear. Podcast fans may find it useful. Its subject seems to be LDS scripture. The item is a curiosity of the archive.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-agrapha: A 1913 entry on the Agrapha — the unwritten sayings of Christ. Anthony Maas gathers them from early writers. It is more blessed to give stands chief among them. The Fathers preserved these echoes. Words of Jesus beyond the Gospels. Their study lights the Gospels' background.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-apocrypha: This 1913 reference article on the Apocrypha — the disputed books of the Bible. George Reid sorts their tangled claims. The Church guards the true canon. The councils drew the line. Scripture's debated borderland. Their tales fill the medieval legends. Their study aids the historian.
